revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement wall full-page background raster asset, vertical portrait 9:16.
Primary request: Create a clean warm-white photo album collectible page background for an achievement medal wall. It should feel like an ivory album page where medals can be displayed clearly.
Scene/backdrop: full-page album sheet, warm white and ivory paper, subtle fine paper grain, very light gray album-page edge, faint stitched or pressed border near the outer edges, soft photographic album margin feeling.
Composition: vertical 9:16 portrait, clean center and middle area reserved for UI medals and text, most decorative details confined to the outer 8-10% margins. Use a gentle page frame and very sparse corner details only. Avoid any busy objects in the center.
Palette: ivory white, warm white, very light neutral gray, tiny hints of pale sage and pale peach only near edges. Overall must read as white/album-like, not yellow.
Style: refined watercolor paper texture, low saturation TripPet handmade stationery style, quiet collectible album feeling, soft tactile paper, elegant and restrained.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no animals, no people, no medals, no icons, no stamps, no strong yellow, no large decorative objects, no dark or busy pattern, no UI mockup elements. Output should be suitable as a background behind colorful circular achievement medals.
